annotations.summary: IBKR 服务不可采集
annotations.description: Prometheus 持续无法采集 IBKR 服务；来源标签包含 service/job/instance。

annotations.summary: Gateway API socket 未监听
annotations.description: Gateway socket 不可用会直接影响 IB API 请求。

annotations.summary: Broker 未连接或未就绪
annotations.description: Broker connected/ready 任一为 0，会影响下单、查单和行情请求。

annotations.summary: 关键磁盘剩余空间低于 8%
annotations.description: 磁盘空间不足可能导致 Prometheus、Grafana、PocketBase 或日志写入失败。

annotations.summary: 关键磁盘剩余空间低于 15%
annotations.description: 需要关注磁盘增长趋势。

model.expr: (sum by (service, route) (rate(ibkr_http_server_requests_total{status_class="5xx"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (service, route) (rate(ibkr_http_server_requests_total[5m])), 0.001) > 0.05) and (sum by (service, route) (increase(ibkr_http_server_requests_total[5m])) > 20)

annotations.summary: 入口 HTTP 5xx 比例升高
annotations.description: 使用 5xx 比例 + 最小请求量判断，避免低流量误报。

model.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, route) (rate(ibkr_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route!~"/health|/status|/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez|/api/custom/ibkr/runtime/config|/ibkr/orders/.*|/api/custom/ibkr/orders/.*|/ibkr/account|/api/custom/ibkr/account.*"}[5m]))) > 15) and (sum by (service, route) (increase(ibkr_http_server_requests_total{route!~"/health|/status|/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez|/api/custom/ibkr/runtime/config|/ibkr/orders/.*|/api/custom/ibkr/orders/.*|/ibkr/account|/api/custom/ibkr/account.*"}[5m])) > 20)

annotations.summary: 入口 HTTP p95 延迟高
annotations.description: 入口请求 p95 超过 2 秒，可能是服务卡住或依赖变慢。

model.expr: (sum by (service, target_service, route) (rate(ibkr_http_client_requests_total{outcome!="success", route!~"/health|/status|/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (service, target_service, route) (rate(ibkr_http_client_requests_total{route!~"/health|/status|/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez"}[5m])), 0.001) > 0.10) and (sum by (service, target_service, route) (increase(ibkr_http_client_requests_total{route!~"/health|/status|/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez"}[5m])) > 50)

annotations.summary: 出站依赖失败率升高
annotations.description: 服务调用 PocketBase、Grafana 或外部接口失败率异常。

model.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, ib_error_code, ib_error_cn, ib_error_action_cn, severity) (increase(ibkr_broker_error_total{severity!="benign"}[5m])) > 3

annotations.summary: IB Broker 错误增多
annotations.description: 5 分钟 IB error 个数超过阈值，来源包含 client_role/ib_error_code/中文含义/处理建议。

annotations.summary: Account summary pacing violation detected
annotations.description: IBKR 返回 account summary pacing code=322，说明仍有请求频率过高或重复订阅。

annotations.summary: Broker pending 请求积压
annotations.description: 待执行 Broker 请求过多，可能导致 Gateway 被打挂或请求超时。

model.expr: sum by (service, environment, operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{operation=~"place_bracket|place_entry|place_take_profit|place_stop_loss|place_bracket_order|place_market_close|adjust_stop_loss|adjust_take_profit|cancel_order|cancel_all_orders|cancel_entry|cancel_take_profit|cancel_stop_loss|modify_manual|modify_order|ibapi_place|ibapi_cancel|modify|cancel", result!~"ok|synced|seen|pending"}[5m])) > 0

annotations.summary: 订单命令失败或未确认
annotations.description: 下单、取消、修改、止盈/止损保护单等订单命令出现失败或未确认。

model.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, operation, result) (rate(ibkr_order_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{operation=~"place_bracket|place_entry|place_take_profit|place_stop_loss|place_bracket_order|place_market_close|adjust_stop_loss|adjust_take_profit|cancel_order|cancel_all_orders|cancel_entry|cancel_take_profit|cancel_stop_loss|modify_manual|modify_order|ibapi_place|ibapi_cancel|modify|cancel"}[5m]))) > 900

annotations.summary: 订单操作 p95 延迟高
annotations.description: 下单、取消、修改或追踪链路变慢。

model.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, operation, result) (rate(ibkr_gateway_order_serial_queue_wait_seconds_bucket[5m]))) > 900

annotations.summary: Gateway 订单串行队列等待过高
annotations.description: IB Gateway order mutation 串行队列等待变慢，可能说明多信号下单/改单/撤单压力过高。

annotations.summary: Gateway 订单串行队列超时
annotations.description: IB Gateway order mutation 等待串行锁超时，需要立即检查下单/改单/撤单链路。

annotations.summary: 主机内存使用率高
annotations.description: 内存使用率持续超过 90%。

annotations.summary: 主机 CPU 使用率高
annotations.description: CPU 使用率持续超过 85%。

annotations.summary: 监控组件不可采集
annotations.description: Prometheus、Grafana、node_exporter 或 Feishu relay 采集异常。

annotations.summary: 账户购买力风控不可确认
annotations.description: 账户购买力风控不可确认，且今日账本兜底未生效；新开仓会等待账户余额/今日账本确认。

annotations.summary: 账户购买力风控使用今日账本兜底
annotations.description: 账户快照刷新受阻，但今日账本兜底已启用；只要今日账户余额覆盖今日已开仓、待提交预占和本次请求，可继续新开仓。

annotations.summary: Account summary pacing storm detected
annotations.description: IBKR account summary pacing code=322 在 10 分钟内出现 >=3 次；应继续使用缓存/冷却，避免继续重试。

model.expr: (max by (service, environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_remaining_usd{source="account_snapshot"}) < bool max by (service, environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_block_floor_usd{source="account_snapshot"})) * (max by (service, environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_remaining_usd{source="account_snapshot"}) >= bool 0)

annotations.summary: 账户剩余购买力低于禁止阈值
annotations.description: 账户剩余购买力低于禁止阈值，新的自动开仓应被阻止。

model.expr: (max by (service, environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_remaining_usd{source="account_snapshot"}) < bool max by (service, environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_warn_floor_usd{source="account_snapshot"})) * (max by (service, environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_remaining_usd{source="account_snapshot"}) >= bool max by (service, environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_block_floor_usd{source="account_snapshot"}))

annotations.summary: 账户剩余购买力接近禁止阈值
annotations.description: 账户剩余购买力低于预警阈值但尚未低于禁止阈值。

model.expr: (max by (service, environment) (max_over_time(ibkr_account_snapshot_available{source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary|account_snapshot_orders_fast"}[10m])) == bool 0) * on (service, environment) (max by (service, environment) (ibkr_account_snapshot_age_seconds{source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary|account_snapshot_orders_fast"}) > bool 900)

annotations.summary: 账户快照不可用
annotations.description: 账户快照超过 15 分钟没有可用的新鲜或可接受缓存数据，购买力、NetLiq 或保证金信息不可信。

model.expr: (max by (service, environment) (max_over_time(ibkr_account_snapshot_refresh_ok{source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary|account_snapshot_orders_fast"}[10m])) == bool 0) * on (service, environment) (max by (service, environment) (max_over_time(ibkr_account_snapshot_available{source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary|account_snapshot_orders_fast"}[10m])) == bool 0)

annotations.summary: 账户快照刷新失败
annotations.description: 账户快照刷新连续失败，且 full/fast/account_summary 当前都不可用；仅在交易安全数据真的不可用时告警。

annotations.summary: IBKR systemd 服务发生重启
annotations.description: IBKR 服务在最近 10 分钟内发生重启，可能导致 Gateway/session/WebSocket 短暂恢复窗口；如同时出现 critical 告警，请优先检查运行态恢复。

model.expr: max by (service, environment) (label_replace(ibkr_gateway_reachable == bool 0, "runtime_check", "gateway_reachable", "service", ".*") or label_replace(ibkr_gateway_session_authenticated == bool 0, "runtime_check", "session_authenticated", "service", ".*") or label_replace(ibkr_gateway_websocket_ready == bool 0, "runtime_check", "websocket_ready", "service", ".*"))

annotations.summary: Gateway/Session/WebSocket 运行态异常
annotations.description: Gateway reachable、session authenticated 或 websocket ready 为 0，会影响交易或行情链路。

model.expr: (max by (service, environment) (max_over_time(ibkr_account_data_circuit_active[5m])) == bool 1) * on (service, environment) (max by (service, environment) (max_over_time(ibkr_account_snapshot_available{source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary|account_snapshot_orders_fast"}[5m])) == bool 0)

annotations.summary: 账户数据请求熔断持续打开
annotations.description: 账户数据请求熔断持续打开，且当前没有可用 full/fast/account_summary 安全数据；单纯 circuit 打开只作为面板诊断。
